source.check: Read from the Newry Reporter's official notice of result, 8 June 1967, p. 8.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. The official notice gives the unopposed returns; the contested divisions (Ballyholland, Crobane, Damolly and Rathfriland North) are not recorded here because the printed vote columns could not be matched to candidates with confidence. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
